records.title: Knowledge Transfer via Convolution Neural Networks for Multi-Resolution Lawn Weed Classification
records.abstractLevel: ResearchGate公开摘要片段（二级证据）
records.abstract: The paper develops a partially transferable convolutional neural network for lawn-weed classification when a new dataset has a different spatial resolution, number of bands, and signal-to-noise ratio. Experiments on simulated image datasets from two sensors examine transferability across spatial resolution, band count, and noise. Dropout between convolutional layers affects partial transfer; even-numbered subsets of source-network layers are more effective under changed spatial resolution. When the source and target have different numbers of bands, layers after the first convolutional layer can be transferred, and transfer is possible when the band counts are not very different.
